title: Dinis: approve the outreach emails' one claim, so Silvio can send from Friday
detail: Silvio asked at the 13:00 stand-up, which Dinis missed. The only claim in the 28 drafts in Silvio's Gmail (and the 50 in people/silvio/outreach/messages.json): 'RiskMandate gives every AI agent one factual record, an Agent Behaviour Policy: what the agent can reach, what the business authorised it to do, and the gap between the two.' Nothing is sent before your yes.
